text: DSH Motion UI（DSH 插件，Web / Desktop 客户端）：把模型回答转成可交互界面、图解与动画。它注册 DSH 工具并在会话正文和智能 UI 侧栏呈现结果，提供原生组件与图表、自由 HTML/SVG 画布、流程和预算场景、机械演示，以及视频预览、MP4 导出和剪辑。用户可检查并继续修改已保存的界面，画布也能导出为独立 HTML。适合需要可视化解释、参数探索、教学演示或制作本地视频的 DSH 用户。普通界面无需额外配置；视频需本机浏览器和 FFmpeg 工具，MiniMax 配音为可选项。

DSH Motion UI adds interactive charts, diagrams and canvases to DSH answers. Create native UI or HTML/SVG, revise saved interfaces, and preview or export MP4 video. Video needs a local browser and FFmpeg; MiniMax narration is optional.
想把复杂说明变成可以点选和调整的界面
有没有办法在 DSH 回答里直接展示图表和交互示意？
让 DSH 用流程图或方案对比来解释问题。
我想做一个能调参数的学习演示或小测验。
能否把生成的界面保存下来，之后接着修改？
帮我把自定义 SVG 动画放进对话中预览。
想把动画画布导出成 HTML 或 MP4。
Can DSH turn an explanation into an interactive chart or visual?
I want to build and revise a small interactive diagram in my DSH chat.
How can I preview an animation and export it as a local video?
DSH Motion UI 的功能「原生交互界面」：模型可调用 render_ui 创建经校验的组件、图表和交互说明，并在回答中呈现可继续编辑的文档。
DSH Motion UI 的功能「自由画布」：调用 render_canvas 提交 HTML、SVG、CSS 与脚本，在独立画布中呈现动画或交互内容；用户还能导出独立 HTML。
DSH Motion UI 的功能「常见场景和机械示意」：render_scene 生成流程、对比、分配或预算界面，render_mechanism 生成可调装配、齿轮或曲柄演示。
DSH Motion UI 的功能「检查与编辑已有界面」：使用 inspect_ui 查看文档，再用 patch_ui 修改属性或 update_ui 增补和替换内容，延续同一已保存文档。
DSH Motion UI 的功能「视频制作」：preview_video 抽取时间轴画面供预览，render_video 将已保存画布导出为 MP4；process_video 可拼接本地片段并处理字幕。
DSH Motion UI 使用 MiniMax 语音合成需要单独配置 mmx 认证或 MINIMAX_API_KEY；这是可选配音功能，普通界面和无声视频不依赖它。（见 lib/voice.js:8-11、51-59）

dsh-motion-ui README · DSH Motion UI：简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

让 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的回答按需变成**可交互界面、图解与动画**：从对比表、测验和参数计算，到 HTML/SVG 画布、机械演示与本地视频制作。模型仍可正常使用文字回答；是否生成界面取决于任务、模型和设置。

dsh-motion-ui README · 能做什么？：| 场景 | 能力 |
| --- | --- |
| 日常说明 | 卡片、对比、流程、时间线、代码、公式与选项卡 |
| 数据探索 | 表格筛选 / 排序、CSV 导出、图表和可调参数 |
| 学习与收集信息 | 本地测验、表单、函数图和结构图解 |
| 自由表达 | 模型生成的 HTML/SVG、动画、基础 3D 和交互画布 |
| 机械演示 | 装配拆解、齿轮和曲柄连杆等可调示意 |
| 视频制作 | 动效时间轴、分镜预览、MP4 导出、剪辑，以及可选的配音和字幕 |

生成的界面可以在正文和 **智能 UI** 侧栏查看；兼容的参数与部分视图状态可保存，后续也可让模型修改已有界面。控件变化在本地响应，只有明确提交后续请求时才会把参数发送给 Agent。

dsh-motion-ui README · 实际生成示例：下图来自开发期的真实 DSH 会话。第一张由 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast 在电路问题中主动生成；第二张由 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 按动画需求生成，展示的是静态截图。效果随模型与提示词变化，示意图不等同于精确仿真。

[查看全部截图及来源](docs/screenshots/README.md)。

dsh-motion-ui README · 兼容性与安装：- 支持 DSH **Web / Desktop**；当前仓库明确声明兼容 `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.1`、`0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.3`、`0.2.1-rc.4`、`0.2.1-rc.5` 和 `0.2.2-rc.1`，以 [package.json](package.json) 为准。
- 要求 Node.js `>=22.19`。日常界面不需要视频工具链；视频制作的额外要求见下文。

Desktop 先在 **应用 → 管理 dsh 命令** 安装桌面版 `dsh`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-motion-ui
```

Web 将 `desktop` 改为 `web`。安装后重启 DSH；Web 还需刷新浏览器页面。插件设置位于 **插件 → 已安装 → dsh-motion-ui**，也可通过 [Enhancement Suite](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-enhancement-suite) 安装。
dsh-motion-ui README · 兼容性与安装：如果安装过开发版 `dsh-generative-ui`，请先卸载旧插件，再安装 Motion UI；两者注册相同工具，不应同时启用。旧界面文档保留兼容读取，但需要在新插件入口重新选择设置。

dsh-motion-ui README · 快速开始：直接提出适合可视化的需求，例如：

- “用可调参数的界面解释电压、电流和功率的关系。”
- “把这两个方案做成对比表，让我调整预算。”
- “做一个带答案解析的本地小测验。”
- “用动画展示齿轮传动，提供转速和暂停控件。”

在插件设置中可选择**引导模式**或**自由模式**。引导模式提供设计指导、风格和示例；自由模式让模型自主设计，不注入这套风格与案例。模型是否主动调用工具，以及界面质量和准确性，取决于模型及请求。

dsh-motion-ui README · 工具与工作方式：| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `render_text` / `render_scene` | 快速文字排版或常见流程、对比、分配和预算场景 |
| `render_ui` | 经校验的原生组件、图表、测验和表单 |
| `render_canvas` | 自由 HTML / SVG 画布与动画 |
| `render_mechanism` | 装配、齿轮、曲柄连杆示意 |
| `ui_catalog` | 按需获取协议、字段和示例 |
| `inspect_ui` / `update_ui` / `patch_ui` | 查看和继续修改已有界面 |

生成过程中可渐进预览已完成的内容；正式交互在结果成功交付并恢复状态后启用。对 PTC / 组合工具调用，部分宿主路径可能只显示文本回退。卸载插件不会自动删除保存在本地的界面状态。

dsh-motion-ui README · 视频制作：明确要求制作视频时，模型可预览时间轴、渲染 MP4、检查视频或拼接片段；也可交付可编辑源码与工程文件。使用前请准备本机 **Chrome / Edge 或 Playwright Chromium、FFmpeg 和 FFprobe**，插件不会自动下载浏览器或编码器。可在插件设置中检查视频环境。

配音可选使用 MiniMax，需要单独配置认证并可能产生 API 费用；没有配音服务也可制作无声动效。普通对话不会自动导出视频。抽帧检查只覆盖采样画面，不等同于完整视觉、音频或内容审核。

dsh-motion-ui README · 限制与安全：- 图表、计算和示意图的正确性取决于输入数据、模型生成和具体实现；专业用途请核对结果。
- 自由画布运行于隔离 iframe，限制对宿主页面及网络的访问；隔离不提供硬性的 CPU / 内存上限，复杂或异常代码仍可能影响页面响应。
- 不要将无关的密钥或私密内容交给生成的画布。外部服务、模型和素材各有自己的使用条件。
- 本项目不声称实现 ChatGPT 的专有 UI 协议或编译器。

dsh-motion-ui README · 更多资料：- [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) · [验证说明](VERIFICATION.md) · [历史详细文档](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-motion-ui/blob/52ad63919cd1b40b26f80a65102ca1459b4a7ec4/README.md)（包含协议与示例；旧安装和兼容性信息可能过时）

dsh-motion-ui README · DSH Motion UI：[简体中文](README.md) | English

Turn [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) responses into **interactive interfaces, diagrams and animations** when useful: from comparisons, quizzes and parameter calculators to HTML/SVG canvases, mechanical illustrations and local video production. The model can still answer in ordinary text; interface generation depends on the task, model and settings.

dsh-motion-ui README · What can it do?：| Use case | Capabilities |
| --- | --- |
| Everyday explanations | Cards, comparisons, flows, timelines, code, formulas and tabs |
| Data exploration | Table filtering / sorting, CSV export, charts and adjustable parameters |
| Learning and input | Local quizzes, forms, function plots and structural diagrams |
| Freeform expression | Model-authored HTML/SVG, animations, basic 3D and interactive canvases |
| Mechanical illustrations | Adjustable assembly, gear and crank-linkage demonstrations |
| Video production | Motion timelines, storyboard previews, MP4 export, editing, and optional voice and captions |

dsh-motion-ui README · What can it do?：Interfaces appear in the response and the **Smart UI** sidebar. Compatible parameters and some view state can be saved, and the model can later edit an existing interface. Controls respond locally; parameters are sent to the Agent only when a follow-up is explicitly submitted.

dsh-motion-ui README · Examples from real generations：These screenshots come from real DSH development sessions. The first was proactively generated by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast for a circuit question; the second was generated by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash from an animation request. Both are static captures. Results depend on the model and prompt, and illustrations are not precision simulations.

[View all screenshots and their provenance](docs/screenshots/README.md).

dsh-motion-ui README · Compatibility and installation：- Supports DSH **Web / Desktop**. The current repository explicitly declares compatibility with `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.1`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.4`, `0.2.1-rc.5` and `0.2.2-rc.1`; see [package.json](package.json).
- Requires Node.js `>=22.19`. Everyday interfaces do not require the video toolchain; see video requirements below.

For Desktop, install its `dsh` command through **Application → Manage dsh Command** first:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-motion-ui
```

dsh-motion-ui README · Compatibility and installation：Replace `desktop` with `web` for Web. Restart DSH after installation; Web users should also reload the browser page. Settings are under **Plugins → Installed → dsh-motion-ui**. You can also install it through the [Enhancement Suite](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-enhancement-suite).

dsh-motion-ui README · Compatibility and installation：If the development plugin `dsh-generative-ui` is installed, remove it before installing Motion UI. They register the same tools and should not run together. Older interface documents remain readable, but settings must be selected again under the new plugin entry.

dsh-motion-ui README · Quick start：Ask for a task that benefits from a visual, for example:

- “Explain voltage, current and power with adjustable parameters.”
- “Compare these two options and let me adjust the budget.”
- “Make a local quiz with answer explanations.”
- “Animate a gear drive with speed and pause controls.”

dsh-motion-ui README · Quick start：In plugin settings, choose **Guided** or **Free** mode. Guided mode supplies design guidance, style and examples; Free mode leaves the design to the model without injecting those styles and examples. Whether the model invokes tools, as well as interface quality and correctness, depends on the model and request.

dsh-motion-ui README · Tools and behavior：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `render_text` / `render_scene` | Quick typography or common flow, comparison, allocation and budget scenes |
| `render_ui` | Validated native components, charts, quizzes and forms |
| `render_canvas` | Freeform HTML / SVG canvases and animation |
| `render_mechanism` | Assembly, gear and crank-linkage illustrations |
| `ui_catalog` | Retrieve protocol, fields and examples on demand |
| `inspect_ui` / `update_ui` / `patch_ui` | Inspect and continue editing an existing interface |

dsh-motion-ui README · Tools and behavior：Completed content can appear progressively during generation. Full interaction starts after a successful result and state restoration. Some PTC / composite tool paths may show the text fallback instead. Removing the plugin does not automatically delete locally saved interface state.

dsh-motion-ui README · Video production：When explicitly asked to make a video, the model can preview a timeline, render MP4, inspect a video or join clips, and deliver editable source and project files. Install **Chrome / Edge or Playwright Chromium, FFmpeg and FFprobe** locally first; the plugin does not download a browser or encoders automatically. The plugin settings can check the video environment.

dsh-motion-ui README · Video production：Optional voice synthesis uses MiniMax, requires separate authentication and may incur API charges. Silent motion videos work without it. Ordinary conversations are not automatically exported as video. Frame sampling checks only selected moments; it is not a complete visual, audio or content review.

dsh-motion-ui README · Limits and safety：- The correctness of charts, calculations and illustrations depends on supplied data, model output and implementation. Verify results for professional use.
- Freeform canvases run in an isolated iframe with restrictions on host-page and network access. Isolation does not provide hard CPU or memory limits; complex or problematic code can still affect responsiveness.
- Do not supply unrelated credentials or private data to generated canvases. External services, models and assets have their own terms.
- This project does not claim to implement ChatGPT's proprietary UI protocol or compiler.
